outcome: The fixed asset schedule (SCR-55) reads live: register, unclear dates, proof and depreciation schedule
acceptance_criteria: `/work/3901` on mock shows the stage, the finding, the register header (entity, provider, period, as-of) and a table of the register's assets; no station track, six facts, agent card or "not available" text appears — verify: open `http://localhost:4990/work/3901`; `frontend/e2e/fixed-assets.spec.ts` asserts the parts are present and absent.
The three assets with `dates` null in `3901` are listed as "Date unclear"; an asset with dates shows its delivery and in-service dates and fraction basis in words — verify: e2e on `3901` and `3905`.

"Open proof" appears only for fact ids in `date_attachment_ids` and opens `/api/v1/work/3905/assets/date-proofs/{fact_id}`; a fact id not in the list has no link and a direct request returns 404 — verify: e2e; unit test on the mapper.
A null money value in `3902` (null `opening_cost`, null `closing_controls.book_value`) renders "Unknown"; no "0" or "0.00" appears for them — verify: unit test on the mapper and e2e text assertion.
`3902` shows `completeness` "Partial"; `3905` shows "Native source verified" as returned — verify: e2e.
`3903` (held schedule) shows the held reason from `schedule.findings[]` and draws no totals as figures; `3905` (ready) shows rows, totals, scope and "Posted to the ledger: No" — verify: e2e.
`3904` (processing, `schedule:null`) shows no schedule section and no review text beyond "No review is open for you." — verify: e2e.

`review_options` render as text only (purpose and verdicts); no Approve, Return, Reject, upload or Correct button exists anywhere on the page — verify: e2e asserts no such buttons; `grep -rn "liveApi.POST" frontend/src/features/fixed-assets` shows nothing.
"Open accounting note" is drawn for `3905` with the returned URL and is absent for `3906` (`accounting_note_url:null`); no placeholder is drawn for the missing note — verify: e2e on both.
`3908` (`register:null`) shows "No register has been captured yet." and the finding — verify: e2e.

`3909` (404) and a live work id the account cannot see both show exactly "This record is unavailable."; `3910` (403 `forbidden`) shows the same wording — verify: e2e and unit test on the error mapping; compare against live with a second account.
A 403 `csrf_failed` on the assets read does not show the no-access state; it refreshes the session once and says to try again — verify: mock scenario `csrf_failed`; unit test counts calls.
A 503 or a dropped network on the panel keeps the work item header and shows "Try again shortly" with Try again; the read is not retried until pressed — verify: mock scenarios; count fetches.

The adapter is registered through F-85's `registerLineAdapter` for key `assets`, returns existing `Section` kinds only, and an unknown panel key elsewhere on the page does not break it — verify: `assetsAdapter.test.ts`; typecheck passes; `git diff` shows no change under `frontend/src/features/workspace/`.

Against live Django (8030, account with the finance role), a real `fixed_assets` work id shows the same register, schedule status and totals as `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/assets` — verify: compare the page with `oa.py live GET /api/v1/work/{work_id}/assets 3` output and the session `curl` JSON.

A second account without access to the case sees "This record is unavailable." on `/work/{id}` and gets 404 from `/api/v1/work/{id}/assets` and its date proofs; no register value appears in the page source — verify: live check with two accounts, view source.

Start schedule from the drawer sends one `POST /api/v1/work` with `line:'finance-ppe/v1'`, `intake:{register_id, prior_id, ledger_id}`, `case_revision` and an `idempotency_key`; pressing twice for the same attempt sends the same key; success opens the new `/work/{id}`; `prior_id` and `ledger_id` are `null` when unchosen — verify: unit test on the request body; network panel; live POST returns 201 and the new id.

Start with a stale `case_revision` (mock scenario 409) re-reads and shows that the case changed; a 422 shows `fields[].message`; a 403 `csrf_failed` asks the person to press again and does not resend by itself — verify: unit tests count fetches.

The drawn parts the API does not supply are absent and listed in the PR: "Chidi never reads asset values", the accounting-note text, the phone short money form, the review dates and "Feeds MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTS" — verify: `grep -rn "never reads asset values\|MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTS" frontend/src/features/fixed-assets` returns nothing.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390 against the six boards (`SCR-55-{desktop,mobile}-{investigating,calculating,verified}`): the frame, header, state tag and the parts that remain match; hidden parts leave no empty heading or gap; amounts show in full on the phone — verify: screenshots at both widths reviewed against `design/screens.md` SCR-55.

Tests exist and pass: unit tests for the mapper (Unknown, held, ready, null link, empty register, dates), the proof-link rule and the start body; `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `delivery/checks.sh` pass — verify: command output.

risk.rationale: Medium. The reads are reshaped from the v7 mock sections into `assets`, and the accounting-note link depends on per-record access (auth). Both are contract-sensitive but contained. Part 1 has no review decisions, uploads, money movement, ledger posting or restricted payroll data, so it can merge under D-180/D-184. The one write, `POST /work`, starts an internal case. The higher-scrutiny work (review decisions) sits in F-102B. Product acceptance is required because live-only fields are added and some drawn parts are hidden.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
